Description
Leeds is a multicultural city and home to 60,000 students, which is reflected in Leeds Beckett University's diverse community – students from 144 countries and territories across the world choose to study here, in one of the most popular student cities in the UK.
Leeds Beckett University is ranked five out of five stars for Internationalization, Facilities, and Inclusiveness and achieved five out of five stars for employability in the QS World Rankings 2019. The International Foundation Year teaches students English language, study and academic skills, so that once they complete their course they can go on to succeed in their chosen degree at the university.
